groups.@pages: heading in the @ menu (links to anything in the workspace) over the pages it found
groups.@assignments: heading in the @ menu over the assignments (homework) it found
groups.@events: heading in the @ menu over the calendar events it found
groups.@files: heading in the @ menu over the files it found
groups.@create: heading in the @ menu over the entries that make a new page or assignment named after what was typed (a verb)

mention.@eventRepeats: under a repeating calendar event in the @ menu; {date} is its first date, like Oct 14
mention.@newPage: @ menu entry that makes a new page and links to it; {query} is what was typed after the @, which becomes the page's title
mention.@newPageHint: under “New page …” in the @ menu: the new page goes inside the page being written in
mention.@newAssignment: @ menu entry that makes a new assignment and links to it; {query} is what was typed after the @, which becomes its title
mention.@newAssignmentHint: under “New assignment …” in the @ menu; Assignments is the name of the view that lists them
mention.@nothingFound: shown in the @ menu when nothing matches what was typed

notHere.@page: shown in place of a link to a page that isn't in this workspace (someone else's page, in a page written together, or one deleted for good)
notHere.@assignment: shown in place of a link to an assignment that isn't in this workspace (someone else's, or deleted for good)
notHere.@event: shown in place of a link to a calendar event that isn't in this workspace (someone else's, or deleted for good)
notHere.@file: shown in place of a link to a file that isn't in this workspace (someone else's, or deleted for good)

deleted.@page: shown in place of a link to a page that is in the Trash
deleted.@assignment: shown in place of a link to an assignment that is in the Trash
deleted.@event: shown in place of a link to a calendar event that is in the Trash
deleted.@file: shown in place of a link to a file that is in the Trash

chip.@markDone: label of the round checkbox on an assignment linked in a page, when the assignment isn't done
chip.@markNotDone: label of the round checkbox on an assignment linked in a page, when the assignment is done

file.@fallbackName: the name shown for a file linked in a page when it has no name or can't be found (a noun)
file.@missing: on a file's card in a page, in place of its size, when the file itself is gone from the computer (it was moved or deleted outside the app)
file.@openInDefaultApp: tooltip of the button on a file's card that opens the file in the program the computer opens that kind of file with
file.@deleted: title of a file's card in a page when the file was deleted
file.@restoreFromTrash: under “Deleted file” on a file's card; the Trash is where deleted things go

database.@fallbackTitle: the name used for a database shown in a page when it has no title (a noun)

callout.@changeIcon: tooltip of the icon at the start of a callout box: click to pick another icon or emoji

flashcard.@front: small heading over a flashcard's first side (the term or question)
flashcard.@back: small heading over a flashcard's second side (the definition or answer)

images.@tooLarge: message when an image added to a page is too big; {size} is the largest size allowed, with its unit, like 25 MB

math.@emptyBlock: shown in an equation block (a formula on its own line) that is still empty; click to write it
math.@emptyInline: shown in a formula inside a line of text that is still empty; click to write it
math.@field: accessible name of the box where a formula's LaTeX source is typed
math.@placeholder: placeholder in the box where a formula's LaTeX is typed; {example} is a sample formula (E = mc^2 or x^2); \ is the backslash key, which opens the list of LaTeX commands. Keep the spaces after {example}
math.@commands: accessible name of the list of LaTeX commands suggested while typing after a backslash
math.@symbols: button under the formula box that shows or hides a palette of math symbols to click
math.@hintBlock: keyboard hint under the box for an equation on its own line: Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on a Mac) finishes, Tab goes to the next empty {} box of the formula; {mod} is the Ctrl key's name (⌘ on a Mac). Inside <kbd> are key names as keyboards in your language label them
math.@hintInline: keyboard hint under the box for a formula inside a line of text: Enter finishes, Tab goes to the next empty {} box of the formula. Inside <kbd> are key names as keyboards in your language label them

palette.@structures: tab of the math symbol palette: fractions, roots, sums, integrals, matrices
palette.@greek: tab of the math symbol palette: Greek letters (α, β, Γ)
palette.@operators: tab of the math symbol palette: ±, ×, ∂, ∞, ∪ and the like
palette.@relations: tab of the math symbol palette: ≠, ≤, ≈, ∈, ⊂ and the like
palette.@arrows: tab of the math symbol palette: →, ⇒, ↔ and the like

math.@casesIf: written into a formula when someone inserts a piecewise definition (\begin{cases}): “value if condition”. Plain words only: no { } \ | $ & # ^ _ % or ~
math.@casesOtherwise: written into a formula when someone inserts a piecewise definition (\begin{cases}), as the last case's condition. Plain words only: no { } \ | $ & # ^ _ % or ~
math.@search: Words that find a LaTeX command when typed after a backslash in a formula (\fract… finds \frac), never shown. Space-separated, lower case. Only the letters a–z can be typed after the backslash, so write words without accents where your language allows; the English words keep working too

search.@int: search word for \int, the integral sign (see the note on this group)
search.@lim: search word for \lim, a limit (see the note on this group)
search.@dv: search word for a derivative dy/dx (see the note on this group)
search.@pmatrix: search word for a matrix in round brackets (see the note on this group)
search.@vmatrix: search word for a determinant, a matrix between bars (see the note on this group)
search.@cases: search word for a piecewise definition, cases one under another (see the note on this group)
search.@operators: search word for operator symbols like ±, ×, ⊕ (see the note on this group)
search.@symbols: search word for symbols like ∂, ∇, ∞, ℏ (see the note on this group)
search.@relations: search word for relations like ≠, ≤, ≈, ≡ (see the note on this group)
search.@arrows: search word for arrows like →, ⇒, ↔ (see the note on this group)
search.@functions: search word for function names written upright, like sin, log, max (see the note on this group)
search.@brackets: search word for \left( … \right), brackets that grow with what they hold (see the note on this group)
search.@overrightarrow: search word for an arrow over a vector's name, like AB with → over it (see the note on this group)
search.@mathcal: search word for calligraphic letters, like ℒ (see the note on this group)
